appDirectory.description: The directory in which your Convex app will be created. For example, `apps/convex`
appDirectory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create your Convex app in?

appName.description: The name of your Convex app. Defaults to the basename of your `appDirectory`.

contractLibDirectory.description: The directory in which your companion contract library will be created. For example, `apps/convex-kore`
contractLibDirectory.x-prompt: Which directory do you want to create your companion contract library in?

contractLibName.description: The name of your companion contract library. Defaults to the basename of your `contractLibDirectory`.

importPath.description: The library name used to import your Convex api, like `@myorg/convex-kore`. Defaults to your `contractLibName`

deferConvexSetup.description: Skip setting up Convex with an existing or new deployment, and instead use template generated files.
